LAW AND MOTION 301, RULING - A R G U E D; THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT LIONEL CHARTRAND'S MOTION TO SET ASIDE CLERK'S ENTRY OF DEFAULT AND DEFAULT JUDGMENT IS DENIED. THE MOTION SEEKING RELIEF UNDER SECTION 473.5 WAS NOT BROUGHT WITHIN A REASONABLE TIME GIVEN THAT DEFENDANT WAS REPRESENTED BY COUNSEL WITH KNOWLEDGE OF THE DEFAULT, AND PLAINTIFF'S UNWILLINGNESS TO VACATE IT FOR MORE THAN SIX MONTHS AND HAD FORMAL NOTICE OF DEFAULT MORE THAN FOUR MONTHS BEFORE FILING THIS MOTION AND NO REASONABLE EXCUSE IS OFFERED FOR THAT DELAY. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO PREPARE A FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN CSR# 8189 301/PJB
